question: Two pipes A and B together can fill a cistern in 4 hours. Had they been opened separately, then B would have taken 6 hours more than A to fill the cistern. How much time will be taken by A to fill the cistern separately?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Test the **options** to see which one satisfies the 4-hour combined time condition.

If **Pipe A** takes 6 hr, then **Pipe B** takes 6 + 6 = 12 hr.

Combined time = (A × B) ÷ (A + B)

Combined time = (6 × 12) ÷ (6 + 12) = 72 ÷ 18 = 4 hr.

Since this matches the given data, the choice is correct.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Combined time for **Pipe A** and **Pipe B** = 4 hr. Let time taken by A be x hr, then B = (x + 6) hr.

**Formula Used:** (1 ÷ TimeA) + (1 ÷ TimeB) = 1 ÷ Total Time

⇒ 1/x + 1/(x + 6) = 1/4

⇒ (x + 6 + x) ÷ (x(x + 6)) = 1/4

⇒ (2x + 6) ÷ (x² + 6x) = 1/4

⇒ 4 × (2x + 6) = x² + 6x

⇒ 8x + 24 = x² + 6x

⇒ x² − 2x − 24 = 0

⇒ x² − 6x + 4x − 24 = 0

⇒ x(x − 6) + 4(x − 6) = 0

⇒ (x − 6)(x + 4) = 0

⇒ x = 6 (Time cannot be negative, so x = 6)

**∴ The correct answer is 6 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Work Rate

If two pipes fill a tank in x and y hours respectively, they together fill it in (xy) ÷ (x + y) hours.

Efficiency and Time Relationship

**Efficiency** is inversely proportional to **Time**. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time.

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

For an outlet pipe (drain), efficiency is taken as **negative** in the work calculation.</p
